tracks.id: Usher - DJ Got Us Fallin' In Love
Justin Bieber - Beauty And A Beat
Black Eyed Peas - I Gotta Feeling
Swedish House Mafia - Don't You Worry Child

transitions.from: Usher - DJ Got Us Fallin' In Love
transitions.why: after Usher's 'DJ got us falling in love' chorus and 'dance like it's the last night of your life', he strips down and Katy drops in one bar before 'There's a stranger in my bed' (video skit skipped)
same key: Katy's 'T.G.I.F... do it all again' rides over We Found Love's intro, low end swaps on bar 4, Rihanna's verse picks up as Katy finishes
right after the first 'we found love in a hopeless place' chorus, a 4 bar strip, and Foxes' pickup 'Cause you are the piece of me' leads Clarity in
Clarity's 'if our love is tragedy' chorus ends, its drop hits and Ne-Yo's 'we might not get tomorrow' pre-chorus rides it for 12 bars (4B to 5B); beats swap exactly on 'Give me everything tonight'

transitions.to: Justin Bieber - Beauty And A Beat
transitions.why: Pitbull's 'I promise tonight' ends his verse over a strip down, Bieber's 'Young money' pickup leads his beat in

transitions.from: Justin Bieber - Beauty And A Beat
transitions.why: 8B to 9B: 'when the music makes you move... time's up' rides over Feel So Close's drop, then Calvin's 'I feel so close to you right now'

transitions.to: Black Eyed Peas - I Gotta Feeling
transitions.why: same key (9B): Calvin's chorus carries over I Gotta Feeling's intro beat, then 'I gotta feeling' takes over

transitions.from: Black Eyed Peas - I Gotta Feeling
transitions.to: Swedish House Mafia - Don't You Worry Child
transitions.why: 9B to 10B: the 'tonight's gonna be a good night' hook rides over the SHM piano, low end swaps, 'I was a king, I had a golden throne' starts as the hook ends

transitions.from: Swedish House Mafia - Don't You Worry Child
transitions.why: the first 'don't you worry child' chorus strips down before the live crowd talk, tempo steps to 139 and 'Do you think about the days' starts
the 'don't think about it too much' hook ends, hard cut into Disturbia's verse
after the 'disturb you' hook, Rihanna's last word stutters (1, 1/2, 1/4 beat loops) and car crash's hook slams in
same key (3B), 139 to 148: 'fall down to your grip again' over a strip down, riser, and Brightside's guitar riff into 'Coming out of my cage'
